_note: Keyed by truth domain. DESIGN is what production quantities read. SITE is kept separately and never overwrites DESIGN; E30 reports the variance between them. A height that is absent is HEIGHT_REQUIRED, which routes to the owner — it is never filled in with a plausible number to remove the warning.
